text:
pm_jordan: Quick sync — planning Q2 hosted API rollout for a two-tier embeddings SKU. Need a decision this week on scope and launch guardrails. High level options below, pick your preferred and call out risks.

eng_sam: thanks. can we keep it narrow? three things to confirm: perf delta, infra cost, quantization complexity.

pm_jordan: agree. proposed options: 
1) Single baseline SKU (current) — minimal infra work, no price change.
2) Perf SKU — lower p95 latency, higher price (more GPU pins, <40ms median).
3) Econ SKU — quantized model, lower cost, slightly higher median latency but within customer SLAs.

product_anna: i'd push for both 2) and 3) long term but propose we ship 1) -> 3) -> 2) as phased rollout if timeline tight. can we get an eval pass to estimate quality delta for quantization?

data_vivian: i can run evals. need canonical embed testset (500 queries) and an alignment metric (cosine drop + downstream recall).

eng_sam: timeline notes: perf SKU requires tuning kernels + KV cache sizing. ~4w to prototype, 8w to validate with autoscale. econ SKU needs quantization toolchain + accuracy checks ~3-5w.

infra_kevin: infra ops: perf SKU will increase pinned GPU hours; pricing model for Dedicated customers may need a reservation mapping. econ SKU lowers RAM but may spike CPU for dequantization.

ops_nick: instrumentation ask: we need these telemetry signals before canary: p50/p95 latency, token cost per request, failure-rate per model-variant, and rate-limited errors. please add rollout dashboards.

pm_jordan: launch guardrails proposal (minimal):
```
- Eval: quality regression <= 1.0% (cosine/recall combined)
- Reliability: failure-rate < 0.1% over 24h canary
- Cost: econ SKU must reduce per-embedding cost >= 30% vs baseline
- Perf: perf SKU p95 embed latency < 60ms in region us-west
```

sales_maya: we have 2 large customers asking for perf SKU SLA (<50ms p95) and one enterprise asking specifically for lower cost embed ops. both are gating purchases on timeline.

product_anna: ok, business asks noted. decision tradeoffs: ship baseline+econ quickly to cover cost request, then prioritize perf for strategic deals.

eng_sam: blocker: autoscaling with continuous batching + perf SKU might regress other models if we pin GPUs. need fallback routing policy (route to baseline when perf capacity congested).

pm_jordan: good call. add fallback policy to rollout plan: prefer perf, fallback to baseline, then econ (if customer accepts lower quality). document: routing priority + customer opt-in.

data_vivian: i'll start eval run tomorrow and post results here (will include cosine histogram + downstream recall delta).

eval_bot: scheduled eval job #742 started for 'embed-quant-eval' against testset_v2. ETA ~48h.

ops_nick: i'll spin up dashboards and a canary alert with runbook. will need owners for oncall during canary — nominate?

product_anna: volunteer list: eng_sam (infra), data_vivian (quality), ops_nick (canary ops), pm_jordan (product owner).

pm_jordan: next steps: 1) collect eval results (Vivian) 2) infra feasibility + perf estimate (Sam & Kevin) 3) cost delta calc (Nick) 4) decide by Fri EOD. please update this thread with short one-line commits.

eng_sam: noted. will post estimate by Thu. :thumbsup:

data_vivian: eval queued, will post numbers Thu morning.

sales_maya: looping in AE leads for customer communication. will draft messaging once we know dates.

pm_jordan: thanks all — marking this thread as the single source for the decision. if you have detailed notes, paste inlined snippets not attachments.
